description: This file is a Polymer Web Component defining the visual ripple effect element `<paper-ripple>`, used to simulate material design ripple animations. It includes HTML template, CSS styles, and JavaScript logic for creating and animating ripples in response to user interactions.

classes.name: Ripple
classes.description: A class managing individual ripple animation states and drawing logic within the `<paper-ripple>` component.

methods.name: addRipple
methods.description: Creates a new ripple instance and adds its container element to the DOM, initiating its animation.

methods.name: removeRipple
methods.description: Removes a ripple instance from the DOM and the internal ripple list.

methods.name: animate
methods.description: Runs the animation frame loop to update all active ripples' visual states.
